fields.name: variant
fields.label: Layout
fields.description: Full bleed sets the words over the section's background image; split puts them beside an image; stacked puts them above one; minimal is words alone.

nextjs.owes: the stored value full-bleed in place of fullBleed

wordpress.owes: the stacked option, and a full-bleed hero that sets its words over the section's background image (SC-006)
wordpress.note: Its full-bleed draws the hero image edge to edge above the text today.

fields.name: eyebrow
fields.label: Eyebrow
fields.description: A short label above the heading. Drawn as a paragraph, never a heading.

fields.name: heading
fields.label: Heading
fields.description: The section's one heading. It becomes the page's main heading when no section above has one.

fields.name: subheading
fields.label: Subheading
fields.description: A plain paragraph under the heading.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.description: Used by the split and stacked layouts. A full-bleed hero uses the section's background image.

wordpress.owes: hiding it for full-bleed and minimal, and moving a full-bleed hero's image to the background image setting (SC-006)

a list of up to two buttons in place of two link fields: cta_primary becomes buttons[0] with style primary, cta_secondary buttons[1] with style secondary; internal links store the document, not its address
